_comment: Realm world-mood rotation. Read by server/Set-Mood.ps1 (-Season, -Event, -List). Mood ids are folder names under mods/presets/. Explained in mods/moods.md.

grim-but-readable.name: Grim but Readable
grim-but-readable.summary: Baseline: cool grey light, mixed weather. The Thaw and the default between arcs.

golden-summer.name: Golden Summer
golden-summer.summary: Warm honey light, thin haze, almost no rain, slightly longer days.

storm-season.name: Storm Season
storm-season.summary: Rain most of the time, slate light, wet fog. Clear skies are rare.

long-winter.name: Long Winter
long-winter.summary: Pale cold sun, low grey skies, icy fog, a bright cold moon.

blood-moon.name: Blood Moon
blood-moon.summary: Red moon nights under clear skies. A weekend overlay, not a season.

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.summary: Brown-grey ash haze, orange sun, dry overcast. A short war-arc overlay.
